dedupe_keys.name: country specific steel production and transport cost inputs

description: This deposit supplies country-specific inputs for assessing the cost and competitiveness of alternative steel-production routes, including hydrogen-based production. Stefan Vögele and collaborators compile public literature and databases into technology-economic and transportation-cost workbooks, with a PDF explaining the basis. Mendeley version 3 publishes the two XLSX files and documentation free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage compares countries and process options; it is not a continuous price series or a complete inventory of operating steel plants. The short repository metadata do not establish a single common reference year or exhaustive country coverage. Source years, currency bases and transport assumptions therefore need checking before combining inputs. A reviewer-assessed use is supplying steel-transition and commodity-transport costs to techno-economic simulations. model-osemosys is a related energy-planning resource, but these tables require an explicit representation of steel processes. No workbook, PDF or cost model was downloaded or executed.
